documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration Of Audited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026
Disclosure Of Information Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015, Reply To Clarification Sought On Spurt In Volume Of Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited Shares
Clarification sought from Chennai Petroleum Corporation Ltd

analysis.summary: CPCL achieved its highest-ever annual crude throughput of 11.71 MMT in FY26, representing 112% of installed capacity. The company reported a full-year Gross Refining Margin (GRM) of $9.2 per barrel and a record total dividend of INR 62 per share. Management is focusing on value-added products through a new INR 1,600 crore LOBS project and the commissioning of 300 retail outlets over the next few years. CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT in FY25, representing 99.5% capacity utilization despite scheduled maintenance turnarounds. The company is advancing the Cauvery Basin Refinery (CBR) project with a revised cost of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects the company's operational and financial momentum to persist into the new financial year.
guidance.quote: To summarize, we continue to deliver resilient operational and financial performance and see the momentum to continue in the new financial year as well.

guidance.claim: The company expects to complete a study on low-cost debottlenecking during the 2026-27 financial year.
guidance.quote: But in the coming year, '26-'27, we hope that ongoing study will get completed.

guidance.claim: Maintenance CAPEX for the next year is expected to be in the Rs. 200-250 crore range.
guidance.quote: Our maintenance CAPEX remains Rs. 200-250 crore range, and the next year forecast also, we feel the CAPEX will be in that range.

guidance.claim: Throughput for FY26 is expected to be higher than the previous year due to lower shutdown impacts.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a throughput which is higher than last year on the operational part.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that current cracks for diesel and ATF are near their long-term averages.
demand_outlook.quote: When I look for a month average kind of a period, I feel I'll be able to sustain the long-term averages.

demand_outlook.claim: The company increased LPG production to meet national requirements amid global supply uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: With global uncertainties affecting the availability of LPG all over the world, CPCL is happy to step up the requirement when the nation needed it.

demand_outlook.claim: Exporting products is viewed as an optional strategy to optimize margins rather than a necessity.
demand_outlook.quote: Export is not a compulsion to me. Export is one of the options available to me to optimize my margins and realization.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a clear shortfall of Motor Spirit in the southern market of approximately 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: Motor Spirit demand in the southern region is projected to grow at 4% to 5%.
demand_outlook.quote: Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%.

demand_outlook.claim: HSD growth in the southern market is forecasted at 2.5%.
demand_outlook.quote: HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL has commenced a Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project with all necessary approvals.
capex_expansion.quote: Some of the important projects that we'll be taking up is Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the Cauvery Basin Refinery project is Rs. 36,354 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has obtained full custody of 1,200 acres of land for the CBR project.
capex_expansion.quote: The most important updates with respect to the project is now we have full custody of the land. So, about 600 acres, which was already with CPCL and another 600 acres, which was acquired in the process, both is in our possession

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL spent Rs. 673 crores on CAPEX during the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a Gross Refining Margin of $13.75 per barrel for the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel

margins_costs.claim: The core GRM for the fourth quarter was $10.3 per barrel.
CPCL recorded a foreign exchange loss of approximately INR 200 crores for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its best fuel and loss percentage of 7.73% during the financial year.
margins_costs.quote: CPCL achieved the best fuel and loss of 7.73%, best MBN of 69.8% and best EII of 84% in the current financial year '25-'26

margins_costs.claim: Niche products currently contribute approximately 15% of the company's margins.
margins_costs.quote: About 7% to 8% constitutes these kinds of niche products. And this 7%–8% is currently contributing around 15% of my margins.

margins_costs.claim: The Gross Refining Margin for FY 2024-25 was $4.22 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel

margins_costs.claim: Fuel and loss for the year was reduced to 8.51%.
margins_costs.quote: in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gain for the fourth quarter was $0.66 per barrel, totaling Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: Average discounts on opportunity crude for FY25 ranged between $1.5 and $2 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: Last year, that is the Financial Year’24-25, the average was around $1.5-$2.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a core GRM of $3.75/bbl and a total reported GRM of $3.40/bbl for the 9M 2024-25 period.
margins_costs.quote:
Core GRM ($/BBl) 12.94 8.21 3.75
Total GRM 7995 6146 1572
CPCL reported GRM ($/BBl) 11.91 8.64 3.40

orders_capacity.claim: The company reached a record distillate yield of 79.1% during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Further, highest ever distillate yield of 79.1%, beating our previous record of 77.6% set in 2019-'20 was also achieved during this year.

orders_capacity.claim: Approximately 90% to 92% of the company's products are sold to Indian Oil Corporation.
orders_capacity.quote: See, 90% of my product is sold to Indian Oil — around 90% to 92%.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, representing 99.5% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity

orders_capacity.claim: Fourth quarter crude throughput reached 113% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The refinery processed 64% to 65% high sulfur crude during the financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the financial year, we have processed almost 64% - 65% of high sulfur.

orders_capacity.claim: Long-term crude sourcing accounts for 55% to 60% of the basket.
orders_capacity.quote: Our long-term sourcing remains at around 55% - 60% and the remaining through spot and the opportunity crudes

orders_capacity.claim: The Manali refinery has an installed capacity of 10.5 MMTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's gross debt-to-equity ratio improved to 0.18 from 0.39 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level as compared to 0.39 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity ratio stood at 0.39 as of March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: When I turn to leverage position, the debt equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: Absolute debt increased to Rs. 3,100 crores from Rs. 2,762 crores in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year

capital_allocation.claim: The CBR joint venture is planned with a 2:1 debt-equity ratio.
capital_allocation.quote: Presently, we are working with a 2:1 debt equity for this JV.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified logistical constraints and crude price volatility as ongoing challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical events caused a 30% to 40% disturbance in Middle East cargo flows over a short period.
risks_headwinds.quote: specifically, if you talk about the Middle East, 30% to 40% disturbance has been observed over a short period is the disturbance that has happened.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in crude prices and international product cracks pose challenges to profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge. Though these broader factors may drive volatility, we remain focused on things we control

risks_headwinds.claim: Maintenance shutdowns impact product processing availability and elevate operating costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: If there are large M&I shutdown that much of product processing availability is under maintenance, that affects profitability. Plus, every M&I shutdown also involves startup and shutdown cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company reported a loss before tax of Rs 374 crore for the 9M 2024-25 period.

management_commitments.claim: The company will commission a significant number of retail outlets in the 2026-27 financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

management_commitments.claim: A scheduled maintenance and inspection of a refinery unit is planned for the September-October period.
management_commitments.quote: But yes, maybe close to September, October, we have a scheduled M&I of one of our refinery units.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to complete its study on low-cost debottlenecking in the upcoming financial year.
management_commitments.quote: But in the coming year, '26-'27, we hope that ongoing study will get completed.

management_commitments.claim: Maintenance CAPEX for the next year is expected to be in the Rs. 200-250 crore range.
management_commitments.quote: Our maintenance CAPEX remains Rs. 200-250 crore range, and the next year forecast also, we feel the CAPEX will be in that range.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects CCEA approval for the CBR project within a few months.
management_commitments.quote: We are awaiting CCEA approval, that process is on, and we expect it in few months.

management_commitments.claim: Refinery crude unit 1 is scheduled for maintenance in August or September 2025.
management_commitments.quote: In 2025, our refinery crude unit 1 which caters to lubes will go into maintenance around August, September.

management_commitments.claim: The company is developing Sustainable Aviation Fuel.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
